Name: Human Population Birth Rate
Description: Rate at which new humans are born.

Name: Vaccination Rate
Description: Proportion of newborns that are vaccinated.

Name: Human Population Natural Death Rate
Description: Natural death rate of humans.

Name: Mosquito Population Natural Death Rate
Description: Natural death rate of mosquitoes.

Name: Rate of Vaccine Immunity Loss
Description: Rate at which vaccinated humans lose immunity.

Description: Efficacy of the vaccine in preventing infection.

Name: Progression Rate from Exposed to Infectious (Vector)
